plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. A way to check each case's category against the requester's rule (C3). No instrument does this. 2. A check of the outbox for all sending calls at once, that can go in the plan (C10). Today only trace of a call does this, at 10 per line, and the 50-unit allowance pays for at most 5 lines out of 100 sends. 3. A way to put scope of a call in the plan for the worker's reads (C5). It can only be asked for on named lines, and the allowance cannot pay for 101 reads. 4. A check that reads the live tables after the promotion. Same set and summary of the change only read the staged set as it was kept, so the tie to the live tables rests on the promotion's line in the record. 5. A way to tell a preview call from a real send in the record. Both carry the same label.
